(

	[AccountPortfolioTypeId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[AccountPortfolioVersion] [varchar](20)  NULL,

	[AccountPortfolioDescription] [varchar](200)  NULL,
	[FinancialProductSubscriptionId] [int]  NULL,
	[GarnishmentId] [int]  NULL,
	[GarnishmentAmount] [numeric](15,5)  NULL,
	[LastReviewDate] [date]  NULL,
	[SourceCode] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [nvarchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,

(

	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
